SOLCAP capture writer API for slots, accounts, bank hashes, transactions, stake rewards, and protobuf blobs

# Purpose
This header declares the public API for `fd_solcap_writer_t`, an opaque writer object used to create SOLCAP capture files, currently `SOLCAP_V1_BANK` files. It defines the object life cycle functions for allocation, initialization, flushing, and deletion, along with the memory alignment and footprint requirements for the backing storage. The file also declares the write functions used to record slot data, account data, bank preimage data, transaction data, stake reward events, and generic protobuf messages into the capture stream.
